categoryIntro.estate: The estate is the everyday hero for families and frequent drivers: plenty of boot space, comfortable on long journeys and still nimble enough for the city. At HoppDrive you can rent estates from well-known brands – ideal for moving house, holidays or transporting larger items.
categoryIntro.suv: SUVs offer a raised seating position, plenty of space and a secure feel on any road – in the city or on alpine passes. Our SUV fleet suits families, trips to the mountains and anyone who appreciates a little more room and ground clearance.
categoryIntro.sedan: Saloons score with a calm ride, a large boot and a smart appearance – perfect for business trips or relaxed long journeys. At HoppDrive you rent saloons at transparent daily rates, fully comprehensive insurance included.
categoryIntro.van: Vans offer maximum space for passengers and luggage and are the first choice for larger groups, families or club outings. Our vans can be rented flexibly – from a single weekend to several months.
categoryIntro.electric: Electric vehicles drive locally emission-free and quietly – ideal for discovering Switzerland with a low carbon footprint. At HoppDrive you rent electric cars with fully comprehensive insurance included, with no charging infrastructure of your own and no purchase costs.
categoryIntro.coupe: Coupés combine sporty design with a direct driving feel – for everyone who does not want to give up the fun of driving, even in a rental car. The two-door body brings style to every trip, from a weekend getaway to a special occasion.
categoryIntro.convertible: A convertible turns every drive into an experience – open-air motoring in the sunshine, whether along a Swiss lake or through the Alps. Rent a convertible at HoppDrive for a special outing or your holiday week.

fallback.priceQuestion: How much does a rental at HoppDrive cost?
fallback.priceAnswer: Our rental cars start from {price} per day.{discounts}
fallback.insuranceAnswer: Yes, fully comprehensive insurance is included with every rental. There are no hidden extra costs for insurance cover.
fallback.durationQuestion: How long can I rent a vehicle?
fallback.durationAnswer: You can rent our vehicles from 1 day up to several months. The longer the rental period, the cheaper the daily rate.
fallback.documentsAnswer: You need a valid driving licence and an ID document (passport or ID card). The rental contract is signed on site at handover.
fallback.extendQuestion: Can I extend the rental period?
fallback.extendAnswer: Yes, an extension is possible at any time, simply get in touch. The price adjusts automatically to the new total duration.
fallback.pickupQuestion: Where can I collect the vehicle?
fallback.pickupAnswer: The vehicle is handed over at our location. You will receive the exact address and directions after the booking confirmation.
fallback.priceAnswerNoPrice: The price depends on the vehicle and the rental period.{discounts}
